digest.component_or_area: plan review gate measurement and evaluation
propositions: Deterministic seeded-defect benchmark harness (mutant corpus assembly, counting helpers, store-clone isolation, run-validity guard) was designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e2 but intentionally not landed on main.

The expensive ~100-run live LLM batch baseline (review_plan sweep and e2_baseline.json/e2_run_validity.json/e2_verdicts.jsonl outputs) is permanently rejected on cost and superseded by d8a5's standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder on main.

Five defect classes are seeded deterministically from real cleanly-closed plans: absent asserted capability, layer-cake split, consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge, unnecessary mechanism, and untagged operational AC.
Pure counting helpers (classify_pair, run_validity) handle PASS/BLOCK/INDETERMINATE verdicts with ≥0.20 INDETERMINATE run-validity cap and are verified by golden tests without LLM.
